relationships.subject: synovial VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Linear regression analysis showed a significant positive correlation between the VAS pain score and indicators including the synovial thickness, the rate of Ki67+ cells, the expression level of IL-1β, TNF-α, VEGF, NGF and the densities of CD31+ vascular endothelial cells and PGP9.5+ nerve fibres (p < 0.05).

relationships.subject: synovial angiogenesis
relationships.evidence_quote: Worsened hypertrophic synovitis, angiogenesis and sensory nerve sprouting in the synovium may play a critical role in causing worse pain sensation in PwH with not bony ankylosed haemophilic arthropathy knees than in those with bony ankylosed knees.

key_findings: Synovia from not bony ankylosed haemophilic knees had higher IL-1β, TNF-α, VEGF, NGF, CD31+ vessel density and higher VAS pain than bony ankylosed knees.
Synovial VEGF, NGF, IL-1β, TNF-α levels correlated positively with VAS pain score.
